evals.prompt: Create a small fishing village called Tidecrest in the Crestfall region. It sits on the western shore of Lake Arden. A few fishermen and a tiny market.

assertions.check: Private file has YAML frontmatter with type: Settlement
Private tags include Settlement, Crestfall, and Tidecrest
Private file has name, region, settlement_type, population, status fields
Private file embeds public file with ![[Public/World/Crestfall/Tidecrest/Tidecrest]]
Private file has ## Notable NPCs section
Private file has ## Guilds & Politics section
Private file has ## DM Notes section
Private dataview query uses FROM [[]] not FROM [[#this.file.name]]
Public file has Overview, Geography, Infrastructure, Economy sections
Public dataview query includes AND "Public" filter
Public file tags include Settlement, Crestfall, and Tidecrest
Files follow 10-second scan rule — fragments over prose, 2-4 bullets per section
Public file has no DM secrets or hidden information

evals.prompt: Create a frontier town called Duskhollow in the Ironpeak Mountains. It has a dwarven blacksmith and a rough tavern. The town is tense because of recent orc raids.

assertions.check: Private file YAML has region: Ironpeak Mountains
Tags include IronpeakMountains (PascalCase no spaces)
Mentions creating the blacksmith and tavern as follow-up (cascading creation)
Current Events or equivalent section mentions orc raids
Does not auto-create NPC/store files without asking the user first
Group/guild links use full private paths if referencing existing groups

evals.prompt: Create a settlement called Highreach in Crestfall.

assertions.check: Detects Highreach already exists in the vault
Does NOT create duplicate files
Offers to review or update the existing files
